title: 安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠
summary: 西班牙格拉納達高原上的安達索爾由三座各 50 MW 的槽式電廠組成，一號廠 2008 年底併網，是歐洲第一座商用槽式電廠，也是世界上第一座配置大型熔鹽儲熱的商用電廠：28,500 噸熔鹽讓它在日落後繼續滿載七個半小時。課程定量分析集熱器數量、儲熱的熱容量、太陽倍數、冬至的餘弦損失，以及躉購費率下的年收入。
summaryEn: Andasol on the Granada plateau in Spain is three trough plants of 50 MW each; unit 1, connected at the end of 2008, was Europe's first commercial trough plant and the world's first commercial plant with large molten-salt storage, 28,500 tonnes of salt carrying it seven and a half hours at full load after sunset. The course quantifies collector count, heat capacity of storage, solar multiple, cosine loss at winter solstice and yearly revenue under the feed-in tariff.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 歐洲第一座商用槽式電廠與第一座商用熔鹽儲熱：回路數、儲熱量、太陽倍數與冬季的餘弦損失
v30FocusEn: Europe's first commercial trough plant and the first commercial salt storage: loop count, stored heat, solar multiple and winter cosine loss

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「集熱器數量與回路」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Field aperture and annual energy" and "Collector count and loops": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field aperture and annual energy" is correct?
options: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。
陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。
集熱器排得越長，就一定越省錢。
optionsEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust.
On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels.
The longer a collector row, the more money is saved.
quiz.explanation: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「鏡場面積與年發電量」如何決定「安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Field aperture and annual energy” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：共 3 座電廠，各 50 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: There are 3 plants of 50 MW each
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「鏡場面積與年發電量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Field aperture and annual energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「鏡場面積與年發電量」的模型 E = DNI·A·η_se，鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = DNI·A·η_se for "Field aperture and annual energy", which value is closest to the annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)?
options: 81.7 GWh
163 GWh
optionsEn: 81.7 GWh
163 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2136 kWh/m²、Ah = 510120 m²、etase = 0.15，得 163 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2136 kWh/m², Ah = 510120 m², etase = 0.15 the result is 163 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡場面積與年發電量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Field aperture and annual energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2136 kWh/m²、Ah = 510120 m²、etase = 0.15，得 163 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 etase 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2136 kWh/m², Ah = 510120 m², etase = 0.15 the result is 163 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise etase by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 180 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 180 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 163 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 etase 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 163 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in etase with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2136 kWh/m²、Ah = 510120 m²、etase = 0.15，得 163 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2136 kWh/m², Ah = 510120 m², etase = 0.15 the result is 163 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 180 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 180 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field aperture and annual energy"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
只要鏡子夠多，聚光太陽熱電廠的效率可以無限提高。
以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With enough mirrors, the efficiency of a concentrating solar plant can rise without limit.
Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.
quiz.explanation: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Field aperture and annual energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
knowledge.textEn: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62862 太陽熱發電廠標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62862 series on solar thermal electric plants. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「鏡場面積與年發電量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field aperture and annual energy" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
集熱器排得越長，就一定越省錢。
optionsEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The longer a collector row, the more money is saved.
quiz.explanation: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡場面積與年發電量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Field aperture and annual energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
knowledge.textEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「集熱器數量與回路」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Collector count and loops" is correct?
options: 集熱器排得越長，就一定越省錢。
儲熱量只看熔鹽有多少噸。
槽式鏡場的基本單元是「集熱器組」：一段大約一百五十公尺長的拋物面槽，由中間的一部液壓驅動器帶動整排一起追日。
optionsEn: The longer a collector row, the more money is saved.
Stored heat depends only on tonnes of salt.
The basic unit of a trough field is the collector assembly, about 150 metres of parabolic trough turned as one row by a hydraulic drive at its middle to follow the sun.
quiz.explanation: 槽式鏡場的基本單元是「集熱器組」：一段大約一百五十公尺長的拋物面槽，由中間的一部液壓驅動器帶動整排一起追日。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The basic unit of a trough field is the collector assembly, about 150 metres of parabolic trough turned as one row by a hydraulic drive at its middle to follow the sun. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集熱器數量與回路：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Collector count and loops: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「集熱器數量與回路」如何決定「安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Collector count and loops” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 槽式鏡場的基本單元是「集熱器組」：一段大約一百五十公尺長的拋物面槽，由中間的一部液壓驅動器帶動整排一起追日。四組集熱器首尾相接成一個回路，油在裡面走六百公尺，溫度升高一百度。把鏡場的總採光面積除以每組集熱器的面積，就得到集熱器的組數；再除以四，就是回路數。設計者透過增減回路數來調整鏡場相對於汽輪機的大小，也就是太陽倍數。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The basic unit of a trough field is the collector assembly, about 150 metres of parabolic trough turned as one row by a hydraulic drive at its middle to follow the sun. Four assemblies end to end form a loop in which oil travels six hundred metres and gains a hundred degrees. Total aperture over the area of one assembly gives the number of assemblies, and dividing by four the number of loops. Designers adjust field size relative to the turbine, the solar multiple, by adding or removing loops. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：每座電廠的採光面積約 51 萬 m²
steps.observationEn: Project file: Each plant has about 510,000 m² of aperture
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集熱器排得越長，就一定越省錢。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The longer a collector row, the more money is saved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「集熱器數量與回路」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Collector count and loops”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The basic unit of a trough field is the collector assembly, about 150 metres of parabolic trough turned as one row by a hydraulic drive at its middle to follow the sun. Four assemblies end to end form a loop in which oil travels six hundred metres and gains a hundred degrees. Total aperture over the area of one assembly gives the number of assemblies, and dividing by four the number of loops. Designers adjust field size relative to the turbine, the solar multiple, by adding or removing loops.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：集熱器排得越長，就一定越省錢。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The longer a collector row, the more money is saved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「集熱器數量與回路」的模型 n = A / a，採光面積 510,120 m²、每組集熱器 817.5 m² 時的集熱器組數最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model n = A / a for "Collector count and loops", which value is closest to the number of collector assemblies for 510,120 m² of aperture at 817.5 m² each?
optionsEn: 624 assemblies
6,240 assemblies
312 assemblies
quiz.explanation: n = A / a；代入 A = 510120 m²、a = 817.5 m²，得 624 組（採光面積 510,120 m²、每組集熱器 817.5 m² 時的集熱器組數）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: n = A / a; with A = 510120 m², a = 817.5 m² the result is 624 assemblies (number of collector assemblies for 510,120 m² of aperture at 817.5 m² each). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 集熱器數量與回路：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Collector count and loops: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集熱器數量與回路」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Collector count and loops” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：n = A / a；代入 A = 510120 m²、a = 817.5 m²，得 624 組（採光面積 510,120 m²、每組集熱器 817.5 m² 時的集熱器組數）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 a 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: n = A / a; with A = 510120 m², a = 817.5 m² the result is 624 assemblies (number of collector assemblies for 510,120 m² of aperture at 817.5 m² each). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise a by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 567 組（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 567 assemblies (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 624 組（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 a 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 624 assemblies (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in a with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: n = A / a；代入 A = 510120 m²、a = 817.5 m²，得 624 組（採光面積 510,120 m²、每組集熱器 817.5 m² 時的集熱器組數）。
knowledge.textEn: n = A / a; with A = 510120 m², a = 817.5 m² the result is 624 assemblies (number of collector assemblies for 510,120 m² of aperture at 817.5 m² each).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 567 組（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 567 assemblies (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集熱器數量與回路」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Collector count and loops"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以每組集熱器的追日角度回饋與出口油溫確認全部回路正常運轉，並統計因故障而散焦的集熱器比例。
只要是晴天，冬天和夏天收集到的熱一樣多。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Tracking-angle feedback and outlet oil temperature confirm all loops run normally, and the share of collectors defocused by faults is compiled.
On a clear day as much heat is collected in winter as in summer.
quiz.explanation: 以每組集熱器的追日角度回饋與出口油溫確認全部回路正常運轉，並統計因故障而散焦的集熱器比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tracking-angle feedback and outlet oil temperature confirm all loops run normally, and the share of collectors defocused by faults is compiled. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 集熱器數量與回路：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Collector count and loops: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集熱器數量與回路」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Collector count and loops” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以每組集熱器的追日角度回饋與出口油溫確認全部回路正常運轉，並統計因故障而散焦的集熱器比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tracking-angle feedback and outlet oil temperature confirm all loops run normally, and the share of collectors defocused by faults is compiled. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：集熱器的長度要以扭轉剛性與風載下的光學誤差決定，驅動器與角度感測器須逐組校準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set collector length from torsional stiffness and optical error under wind, and calibrate drives and angle sensors assembly by assembly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一百五十公尺長的集熱器只由中間一點驅動，兩端因扭轉變形而落後幾個毫弧度，端部的截取率下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A collector 150 metres long driven at one point in the middle lags by milliradians at its ends through torsion, lowering intercept there. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以每組集熱器的追日角度回饋與出口油溫確認全部回路正常運轉，並統計因故障而散焦的集熱器比例。
knowledge.textEn: Tracking-angle feedback and outlet oil temperature confirm all loops run normally, and the share of collectors defocused by faults is compiled.

knowledge.textEn: Set collector length from torsional stiffness and optical error under wind, and calibrate drives and angle sensors assembly by assembly.

knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：SolarPACES 定日鏡與反射鏡量測指引。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: SolarPACES guidelines for heliostat and reflectance measurement. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「集熱器數量與回路」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Collector count and loops" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
儲熱量只看熔鹽有多少噸。
一百五十公尺長的集熱器只由中間一點驅動，兩端因扭轉變形而落後幾個毫弧度，端部的截取率下降。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
Stored heat depends only on tonnes of salt.
A collector 150 metres long driven at one point in the middle lags by milliradians at its ends through torsion, lowering intercept there.
quiz.explanation: 一百五十公尺長的集熱器只由中間一點驅動，兩端因扭轉變形而落後幾個毫弧度，端部的截取率下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A collector 150 metres long driven at one point in the middle lags by milliradians at its ends through torsion, lowering intercept there. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 集熱器數量與回路：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Collector count and loops: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集熱器數量與回路」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Collector count and loops” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一百五十公尺長的集熱器只由中間一點驅動，兩端因扭轉變形而落後幾個毫弧度，端部的截取率下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A collector 150 metres long driven at one point in the middle lags by milliradians at its ends through torsion, lowering intercept there. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計者透過增減回路數來調整鏡場相對於汽輪機的大小，也就是太陽倍數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Designers adjust field size relative to the turbine, the solar multiple, by adding or removing loops.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集熱器排得越長，就一定越省錢。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The longer a collector row, the more money is saved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一百五十公尺長的集熱器只由中間一點驅動，兩端因扭轉變形而落後幾個毫弧度，端部的截取率下降。
knowledge.textEn: A collector 150 metres long driven at one point in the middle lags by milliradians at its ends through torsion, lowering intercept there.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
